guide_title.speaker: narrator
guide_title.text: Welcome to Playtime Prank RPG 3D with Lily Lovebraids, Giblet, and Chum Chompkins! Tap Play!

guide_welcome.speaker: sahur
guide_welcome.text: Chum Chompkins here! Tap the glowing Tea Party Gift Box right in front of us!

guide_starter_pop.speaker: narrator
guide_starter_pop.text: Awesome! Golden Crumpet Stars, a Prank Pod Kit, and a Free Gadget Spin!

guide_tap_block.speaker: narrator
guide_tap_block.text: Tap any glowing Prank Box to bonk it three times with your GrabPack Hand!

guide_combo_sahur.speaker: sahur
guide_combo_sahur.text: Boing, slap, splash! Super Stretchy Braid and Crumpet shockwave combo!

guide_boing_hint.speaker: narrator
guide_boing_hint.text: Boing! Stretchy pigtail bounce! Spin the wheel for a stronger prank gadget first!

guide_ready_tralalero.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_tralalero.text: GrabPack Hand ready! Let us prank Tea Pod Gracie in the Pink Capsule Lab!

guide_ready_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_bombardiro.text: Purple Braid Whip ready! Let us share crumpets with Hungry CatNap by the Fridge!

guide_ready_patapim.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_patapim.text: Spring Boots on! Let us unscrew Tiny-Legs Prototype on the Critters Soccer Court!

guide_ready_king.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_king.text: Makeup Blaster ready! Give the Clown Mech Boss a rainbow makeover in the Workshop!

vo_wpn_bat.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_bat.text: Blue and Red GrabPack Hand! Stretchy high-five power for popping prank crates!

vo_wpn_gong.speaker: cappuccina
vo_wpn_gong.text: Swish boing! My Purple Braid Whip blocks soccer balls and tickles bosses!

vo_wpn_mallet.speaker: bananini
vo_wpn_mallet.text: Ding ding! Breezy-Bake Crumpet Teapot Launcher! Fresh golden crumpets for everyone!

vo_wpn_taiko.speaker: lirili
vo_wpn_taiko.text: Puff sparkle! KickinChicken Rainbow Makeup Blaster! Instant silly clown makeover!

vo_wpn_rainbow.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_rainbow.text: Ultimate Jackpot! The Prank Remote and Magnet Wrench of Champions!

vo_totem_tier1.speaker: bananini
vo_totem_tier1.text: Hooray! The Pink Capsule Tea Pod is open and popping silly Tea-Party Hats!

vo_totem_tier2.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier2.text: Yum! My Dollhouse Breezy-Bake Crumpet Oven and Stocked Fridge are baking golden stars!

vo_totem_tier3.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier3.text: Whoa! The GrabPack Prank Turret is launching rainbow makeup and stretchy braids!

helper_cappuccina_wake.speaker: bananini
helper_cappuccina_wake.text: Giblet here! Pink Capsule Tea Pod ready with fancy bowties and teacup hats!

helper_bananini_wake.speaker: cappuccina
helper_bananini_wake.text: Lily Lovebraids reporting! Welcome to my Dollhouse Tea Party and Crumpet Kitchen!

helper_lirili_wake.speaker: sahur
helper_lirili_wake.text: Chum Chompkins belly laugh! Extra crumpets, cookies, and silly belly bounces!

helper_assassino_wake.speaker: lirili
helper_assassino_wake.text: Hoppy, KickinChicken, and Baba Chops here! Our GrabPack Prank Turret is online!

fairy_pot_max.speaker: cappuccina
fairy_pot_max.text: All four Tea Party Prank Stations are maxed out! Golden Crumpet Star fountain!

fairy_need_stars.speaker: narrator
fairy_need_stars.text: Collect more Crumpet Stars or win the earlier Prank Boss Trophy first!

wheel_open.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_open.text: Spin the Prank Gadget Wheel for a stretchy braid, teapot, or makeup blaster!

wheel_spinning.speaker: sahur
wheel_spinning.text: Round and round the Tea Party Prank Wheel goes! What gadget will we get?

wheel_jackpot.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_jackpot.text: Tea Party Jackpot! Bonus Crumpet Stars and a glowing ribbon shield heart!

vo_drop_jackpot.speaker: sahur
vo_drop_jackpot.text: Whoa! Stocked Dollhouse Fridge Crumpet Star Shower!

vo_drop_seed.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_seed.text: A Prank Pod Kit! Tap Prank to build a Tea Pod, Crumpet Oven, or Turret!

vo_drop_wheel.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_wheel.text: Free Spin Token! Let us spin the Prank Gadget Wheel!

vo_drop_mango.speaker: narrator
vo_drop_mango.text: Yum! Warm Breezy-Bake Golden Crumpets and Strawberry Tea!

vo_drop_latte.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_latte.text: Sweet Berry Tea Zoom! Super fast feet and a bonus ribbon heart!

vo_drop_bananini.speaker: sahur
vo_drop_bananini.text: Hehe! Mini Chum Chompkins popped out giggling!

vo_drop_confetti.speaker: bananini
vo_drop_confetti.text: Hooray! Rainbow Ribbon Confetti and Mini Giblet Tea Buddy!

vo_drop_toot.speaker: lirili
vo_drop_toot.text: Boing whoop! Silly Whoopee Cushion and Mini Hoppy Hopscotch!

vo_gear_boots.speaker: lirili
vo_gear_boots.text: Hoppy Bouncy Spring Boots! Zoom and jump across the Dollhouse!

vo_gear_crown.speaker: cappuccina
vo_gear_crown.text: Fancy Pink Capsule Tea-Party Hat! Five glowing ribbon shield hearts!

vo_gear_cape.speaker: cappuccina
vo_gear_cape.text: Lily Lovebraids Ribbon Cape! Super Crumpet Star magnet!

vo_boss_alert.speaker: sahur
vo_boss_alert.text: Ooh! Tea party prank alert! A Giant Playtime Boss just walked in!

vo_pet_cappuccina.speaker: bananini
vo_pet_cappuccina.text: Hehe! Mini Giblet loves high-fives and shares extra Crumpet Stars!

vo_pet_bananini.speaker: sahur
vo_pet_bananini.text: Yum yum! Happy Mini Chum Chompkins shares golden snacks with you!

vo_pet_lirili.speaker: lirili
vo_pet_lirili.text: Boing boing! Mini Hoppy Hopscotch cheers for our soccer goal!

boss_tralalero_spawn.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_spawn.text: Step into my Pink Capsule Pod! Every proper guest needs a fancy makeover!

boss_tralalero_boing.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_boing.text: Teacup bounce! Spin the wheel for a GrabPack Hand before our tea party!

boss_tralalero_ouch.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_ouch.text: Oh my ribbons! That Pink Capsule Pod just put a giant teacup hat on my head!

boss_tralalero_defeat.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_defeat.text: Hehe, this silly Tea-Party Hat and bowtie actually look fabulous! Take my Trophy!

vo_win_tralalero.speaker: narrator
vo_win_tralalero.text: Hooray! Tea Pod Gracie is wearing her silly teacup hat! Trophy one!

boss_bombardiro_spawn.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_spawn.text: Meow rumble! My tummy is grumbling by the Dollhouse Fridge! Where are the snacks?

boss_bombardiro_boing.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_boing.text: Purr bounce! Bring Lily Purple Braid Whip or a warm crumpet first!

boss_bombardiro_ouch.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_ouch.text: Ooh! Fresh Breezy-Bake golden crumpets and butter! Those smell delicious!

boss_bombardiro_defeat.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_defeat.text: Purr! My tummy is full of warm golden crumpets! Let us be best friends! Take my Trophy!

vo_win_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
vo_win_bombardiro.text: Awesome job! Hungry CatNap loves our Breezy-Bake crumpets! Two trophies won!

boss_patapim_spawn.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_spawn.text: Clank stomp! Nobody can score past Lily stretchy braids or my giant spider legs!

boss_patapim_boing.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_boing.text: Clang bounce! Put on Spring Boots and grab the Crumpet Teapot Launcher first!

boss_patapim_ouch.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_ouch.text: Hey! Stop unscrewing my giant spider legs! Everyone will see my tiny little shoes!

boss_patapim_defeat.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_defeat.text: Oh no, my giant legs popped off and my tiny goofy legs are out! Take my Trophy!

vo_win_patapim.speaker: narrator
vo_win_patapim.text: Haha! Look at Tiny-Legs Prototype dancing in his tiny shoes! Three trophies!

boss_king_spawn.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_spawn.text: Beep boop! Behold my giant Stained-Glass Workshop Spider-Mech!

boss_king_boing.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_boing.text: Buzzer bounce! Bring KickinChicken Makeup Blaster or the Prank Remote to prank me!

boss_king_ouch.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_ouch.text: Honk honk! Why am I wearing a rainbow afro wig, big red clown nose, and polka dots?

boss_king_defeat.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_defeat.text: Honk giggle! Lily, Giblet, Chum, and the Smiling Critters win the Silly Prank Party!

vo_win_king.speaker: narrator
vo_win_king.text: We did it! All four Playtime Prank Trophies won! Crumpet tea party time!

vo_finale_parade.speaker: cappuccina
vo_finale_parade.text: Grand Dollhouse Tea Party! Golden crumpets, stretchy braids, and giggles for everyone!

vo_keep_playing.speaker: narrator
vo_keep_playing.text: Welcome back to Lily Lovebraids and Giblet Tea Hub! Let us keep pranking!

vo_chaos_on.speaker: sahur
vo_chaos_on.text: Silly Prank Chaos Mode on! Every Gift Box pops double crumpet and makeup surprises!

vo_chaos_off.speaker: narrator
vo_chaos_off.text: Cozy Tea Party Mode! Sunny Dollhouse adventure!

sahur_sleepy_zzz.speaker: narrator
sahur_sleepy_zzz.text: Hold on! That Prank Boss is still getting dressed! Win the earlier trophy first!
